'''Rymar Quinn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Rymar came from a [[Quinn family|long line]] of Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and in [[3680 BBY]]<ref name="Date-2">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' states that [[Malavai Quinn]] was thirty-seven during the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Quinn is first encountered by the [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]] class in Act I of the [[Star Wars video games|game]], which can be placed in [[3643 BBY]] per the [[Template:TOR_dates/1|reasoning here]]. Additionally, {{TORcite|type=conversation|Malavai Quinn|Incompetent}} places the [[Battle of Talay]] before Quinn's [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]], and the battle must be part of the [[Great Galactic War]], which begins in [[3681 BBY]] per the ''Encyclopedia''. Thus, Quinn's age of thirty-seven must be relative to his first appearance in Act I in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], as it gives him a birth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[3680 BBY]].</ref>&mdash;relatively early in Rymar's own life&mdash;he had a son he named [[Malavai Quinn|Malavai]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Rymar's strict instruction in Malavai's childhood inspired his son's rigid bearing and unyielding loyalty to the Empire. Colonel Quinn was [[Death/Legends|killed]] while serving in the [[Battle of Rhen Var]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> at some point between [[3660 BBY]] and [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> though Malavai followed in his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] footsteps by enlisting in the Imperial Military.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rymar Quinn was mentioned in Malavai Quinn's entry in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a [[2012]] reference guide. The entry states that Rymar died young at the Battle of [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> but the placement of the battle in the final quarter of the Great Galactic War on the ''Encyclopedia''{{'s}} timeline contradicts this,<ref name="Date" /> as Malavai was already in his twenties by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the battle.<ref name="Date-2" />
